title: Enhanced thermoelectric performance of PEDOT:PSS/SWCNT/PDDA three-component composite films
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,50142-50150
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08134C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mustapha Adamu, Muhammad Nadeem, Muhammad Hasnain, Asim Ullah, Tafoor Afzal, Na Fan, Yuanrong Bao, Fei Jiao
To address the high interfacial resistance of conducting polymer/carbon nanocomposites, we use PDDA as a multifunctional interfacial architect. The bilayer composite film achieves a high power factor of 472 ± 40 µW m−1 K−2, highlighting the key role of rational interfacial design.
